rwc-read-latency.pdf.note:
Coordinator cache off; Native in-process, owner RPC; one data SSD on different hosts
Cold: device-qualified; warm: prewarmed page cache. Read lanes: Native 0; owner 1 at c1, 4 at c16
p50 lines; + p99; r0 solid/filled, r1 dashed/open. Unqualified cases have no latency marker.

rwc-throughput.pdf.note:
Writes: Native page cache is not durable; per-put/grouped barriers vs owner covering fdatasync
Reads: coordinator cache off; cold device-qualified, warm prewarmed; Native in-process (0 lanes)
Owner c1/c5: 1 lane, c16: 4. Shaded c5* is lane-limited, not a transport ranking.
Finite-case rates, not capacity; r0 filled/solid, r1 open/dashed; in-flight/offered counts in evidence.

Linear axes; no latency subtraction; no cross-reader comparisons.

rwc-floors.pdf.note:

API c1: covering-sync writes; cold qualified / warm prewarmed; coordinator cache off; 1 owner read lane
Filled r0, open r1/r2; network ticks specify units; other x axes in KiB. No 8 KiB network or 1/8 KiB SSD read floor.
